description: This Swift source file defines the `AgentWorkspace` enum, which manages workspace files and templates for an AI agent framework. It includes functions for path resolution, workspace inspection, safety checks, and default template generation.

classes.name: BootstrapSafety
classes.description: Represents the safety status of a workspace, indicating whether it is considered safe or blocked, with an optional reason.

methods.name: displayPath
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly string representing the workspace URL path, replacing home directory with '~' when appropriate.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Resolves a workspace URL from user input, expanding tildes and defaulting if input is empty.

methods.name: agentsURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for the AGENTS.md file within the workspace.

methods.name: workspaceEntries
methods.description: Lists entries in the workspace directory, filtering out ignored entries.

methods.name: isWorkspaceEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the workspace directory is empty.

methods.name: isTemplateOnlyWorkspace
methods.description: Determines if the workspace contains only template files.

methods.name: bootstrapSafety
methods.description: Assesses the safety of a workspace folder before bootstrap procedures.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes a new workspace by creating necessary files and directories with default templates.

methods.name: needsBootstrap
methods.description: Checks whether the workspace requires bootstrap initialization.

methods.name: hasIdentity
methods.description: Checks if the workspace contains a non-empty IDENTITY.md file.

methods.name: identityLinesHaveValues
methods.description: Helper to verify if IDENTITY.md contains non-empty identity data.

methods.name: defaultTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for AGENTS.md onboarding instructions.

methods.name: defaultSoulTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for SOUL.md, defining agent persona and boundaries.

methods.name: defaultIdentityTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for IDENTITY.md for initial agent identity.

methods.name: defaultUserTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for USER.md for user profile information.

methods.name: defaultBootstrapTemplate
methods.description: Provides the initial bootstrap instructions for first-time setup.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads template content from various possible locations, falling back to default.

methods.name: templateURLs
methods.description: Generates an array of URLs where templates might be stored, including resources, current directory, and development paths.

methods.name: devTemplateURL
methods.description: Determines the path to potential development templates within the repository.

methods.name: stripFrontMatter
methods.description: Removes YAML front matter from a template content string to extract usable content.
